entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return an item. Order number is VF77-B3-9012.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF77-B3-9012. I see it here, an AeroSafe Helmet. What specifically is the issue with it?
There's no issue, I just need to return it. The color wasn't what I expected. Can I return it or not? Yes or no.
I can certainly check that for you. I see the delivery date was about 70 days ago. Is the item still in its original condition?
Yes, the box is unopened. It's brand new.

Perfect. Let me just confirm the policy. Yes, standard items like that helmet have a 90-day return window. Since you're within that period, I can absolutely process this for you. We just have to be strict about that for safety reasons with protective gear.
Great. So you're approving it? What's the next step?

Yes, it's approved. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now. Just print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off with any major carrier. You should see the email in the next few minutes.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
